title: PhysxSDFMeshCollisionAPI
summary: Signed-distance-field cooking parameters for a Mesh collider with physics:approximation sdf. Two-stage gate: the API must be in usd-schemas and sdfResolution must be positive, otherwise the mesh cooks as a plain triangle mesh. Cooking inputs only; nothing here is verified. Several absent-column seeds differ from the USD schema fallbacks.
producer_scope: Every declared attribute of an applied collision API is published at its resolved value; all seven columns land as their raw fallbacks when unauthored. No derivation.

columns.name: physxSDFMeshCollision:sdfResolution
columns.absent: 0, which fails the validity gate: the SDF parse gives up, no SDF field is read, and the collider cooks as a plain triangle mesh (which PhysX then rejects on a dynamic body). The USD schema fallback 256 is what the producer publishes, so a hand-populated stage must write this column to get an SDF at all. The cooking default 256 is never used as the seed.

columns.name: physxSDFMeshCollision:sdfSubgridResolution
columns.absent: 6, the SDF cooking default. 0 selects a dense SDF.

columns.name: physxSDFMeshCollision:sdfBitsPerSubgridPixel
columns.absent: 16 bits per subgrid pixel. Accepted tokens BitsPerPixel8, BitsPerPixel16, BitsPerPixel32 map to 8, 16, 32; an absent column or any other token keeps 16.

columns.name: physxSDFMeshCollision:sdfNarrowBandThickness
columns.absent: 0.0: the parser seeds a local 0.0, reads into it, and assigns it back unconditionally, so an absent column yields 0.0 rather than the cooking default 0.01. The producer publishes the USD fallback 0.01.
columns.notes: Fraction of the mesh bounding-box diagonal, not a length.

columns.name: physxSDFMeshCollision:sdfMargin
columns.absent: 0.0 by the same seed-and-assign-back pattern as sdfNarrowBandThickness, rather than the cooking default 0.01. The producer publishes the USD fallback 0.01.
columns.notes: Fraction of the mesh bounding-box diagonal, not a length.

columns.name: physxSDFMeshCollision:sdfEnableRemeshing
columns.absent: false (same seed-and-assign-back pattern; here it matches the cooking default).

columns.name: physxSDFMeshCollision:sdfTriangleCountReductionFactor
columns.absent: 0.0 by the same seed-and-assign-back pattern, rather than the cooking default 1.0 (keep every triangle). The producer publishes the USD fallback 1.0.

interactions.rule: Read only for descriptor kind sdf, and only when this API is in usd-schemas and sdfResolution > 0. Every other approximation forces sdfResolution to 0 on its descriptor.
An sdf mesh also reads physxTriangleMeshCollision:weldTolerance for its triangle-mesh cooking.

findings.summary: Absent column yields 0.0 instead of the header default 0.01 because the parser re-seeds a local to 0.0 and assigns it back unconditionally. USD population publishes the schema fallback 0.01, so only a hand-populated stage that omits the column is affected. Cooking input, not a PhysX default.
Absent column yields 0.0 instead of the header default 0.01, same pattern as sdfNarrowBandThickness. Cooking input, not a PhysX default.
Absent column yields 0.0 instead of the header default 1.0, same pattern. Cooking input, not a PhysX default.

Absent column yields 0 and disables the SDF entirely (the field falls back to triangle-mesh cooking) instead of the header default 256. USD population publishes 256. Deliberate validity probe in the parser; recorded so a hand populator knows the column is effectively mandatory.

notes: Cooking APIs on a Mesh cannot be verified by the generated tests: the parameters only change the cooked PxTriangleMesh SDF, which exposes no getter for them, and the builder writes no mesh arrays.
